facts.title: chemical release during transfer operations on TK-8310

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the restraint and placarding of transported loads on TK-8310 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on TK-8310 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure. TK-8310 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 4 June 2025 an incident occurred on TK-8310 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
